question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a purple ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a yellow ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Eve swap balls. Finally, Bob and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) purple ball
(C) teal ball
(D) white ball
(E) yellow ball
(F) grey ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: red, purple, teal, white, yellow, grey, pink
1. Claire ↔ Gertrude: red, purple, pink, white, yellow, grey, teal
2. Dave ↔ Bob: red, white, pink, purple, yellow, grey, teal
3. Claire ↔ Bob: red, pink, white, purple, yellow, grey, teal
4. Claire ↔ Bob: red, white, pink, purple, yellow, grey, teal
5. Claire ↔ Eve: red, white, yellow, purple, pink, grey, teal
6. Bob ↔ Eve: red, pink, yellow, purple, white, grey, teal
7. Bob ↔ Claire: red, yellow, pink, purple, white, grey, teal
Alice has the red ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
